headline: Executive order extends two White House science and technology advisory committees so they can keep operating.
what_it_does: This order extends the life of the President's Information Technology Advisory Committee and the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. These are groups of outside experts that give the President advice. Without an extension, advisory committees like these would end on a set date. No summary was provided, so details such as the new end date are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the two advisory committees
who_it_affects.how: They can continue serving and advising the President on information technology and science policy.
